input.title: Protein FASTA file(s)
input.description: Pick one or more protein FASTA files from this project. In monomer mode every sequence is predicted on its own; in complex mode each file is one complex.

mode.title: Prediction type
mode.description: monomer: predict every sequence on its own. complex: each FASTA file is one complex, its sequences the chains.

num_models.title: Models per prediction
num_models.description: AlphaFold2 models per prediction. 1 is a quick check; 5 ranks five models.

title.title: Viewer title
title.description: Title shown at the top of the results viewer

msa_mode.title: MSA search
msa_mode.description: MSA search. single_sequence sends nothing to the MSA server but gives much weaker predictions.

pair_mode.title: MSA pairing (complexes)
pair_mode.description: How MSAs of different chains are paired for complexes

max_residues.title: Maximum residues per prediction
max_residues.description: Largest prediction allowed (total residues). Larger ones need more GPU memory.

colabfold_version.title: ColabFold version
colabfold_version.description: ColabFold release installed at run time
